description: The same application secrets kept out of the repo three ways: a Bitnami SealedSecret (kubeseal output, asymmetrically encrypted for the in-cluster controller), a SecretProviderClass that mounts them from AWS Secrets Manager via the Secrets Store CSI driver, and a service-account-token Secret with no data that the control plane populates. None of them stores a base64 value in the manifest. VC115 must not fire.
